title: OP Loot Drop
description: Select an item such that when a player drops it, it drops OP loot. Perfect for manhunts :)
body:
# Custom Items Drop OP Loot!

## Usage 
If you **press Q** while holding an item (or drop it in other ways), it will select 1-3 random OP items and drop it instead of the item. It disposes of the item used. Perfect for manhunts or some other cool ideas.

## Command
Command usage: /oploot <set|enable|disable|get>
OP is required to use the command.
